decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is occupied.

Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted for __chiropractic clinic____________________ purposes shall not be carried on outside the following times _8am-6pm Monday to Saturday_____________________________.

Condition : 4 - The premises shall be used for ..a chiropractic clinic.................... and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class D1       of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).
Condition : 5 - A shop window display that complements the character of the shopping centre shall be maintained
description: Change of use from estate agents (A1) to chiropractic clinic (D1) use
